verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS feature-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions an interactive API reference or runnable examples. API access tokens, the CLI and the MCP server are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here, and probes of the candidate OpenAPI/Swagger spec paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
